status: Prospective conditional model forecast; no measured outcome.
model: FLINT 1.1 sealed chamber with combustion products. Each burn starts in fresh gas.
probabilities: See sealed v1; no revision to binary probabilities or comparator.

resolution.yes: The official burn record reports self-sustained flame spread beyond the igniter-influenced region.
resolution.no: A nominal ignition attempt produced no ignition, or the official record reports no such spread after power ended.
resolution.pending: No attributable official result available. Retain the source, test identifier, actual conditions, and outcome rationale for each resolution.
resolution.void: Insufficient telemetry, changed material or geometry, invalid initial conditions, hardware fault, abort, or ambiguous classification.
resolution.missing_policy: Score only resolved tests on matched indices. Report coverage. A full four-burn score requires four resolved tests.

length_scoring: For valid burns with attributable measured sustained travel, report signed and absolute error in cm and number available. Reference lengths are point scenarios at the mean limit.
comparison: Report v1 and v2 side by side for the same qualifying official lengths. Do not select the better forecast after seeing outcomes.
